profile.headline: Software Engineer at DoorDash
profile.summary: I am an experienced software engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. I can work on a wide range of backend stack from writing Linux kernel modules for device drivers to developing a microservice using Spring Framework and AWS. I've worked on different programming languages such as Java, C, C++, Python, Kotlin, and Javascript.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-develop Linux kernel module for BACnet MSTP implementation.
- Review architecture on a regular basis for feature improvements
- Develop a portable test framework for our entire software stack.
- Help the team on data migration from Predix to AWS infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer Advanced
positions.description:
- Developed micro-services that leverage AWS services such as AWS Neptune, ElastiCache, RDS, etc.
- Maintained and improve CI/CD pipelines using Gitlab and Terraform
- Improved development process by using Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop micro-services that provide RESTful APIs.
- Develop state-of-the-art micro-services using technologies such as RabbitMQ, Spark, Cassandra, Postgres, and Drools.
- Develop simulators for data ingestion.
- Improve testing automation platforms for more efficient integration testing for the entire team.

positions.title: Text Data Processing Intern
positions.description:
- Develop a prototype Q&A Android application.
- Analyze unstructured data and find ways to organize them.
- Use Solr for unstructured text indexing and analysis

positions.title: Smart Phone Application Development Intern
positions.description: I developed a prototype Android application that receives and saves different sensor data (via Bluetooth) from two different hardware sources. This project required the implementation of threads and Bluetooth sockets.

honors.title: Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by San Jose State University · Dec 2015

projects.title: EZtimate Finder Subsystem
projects.description:
This is a senior project that resulted in an intellectual property creation— the only submission this decade to the university, by the Computer Engineering Department, for approval to apply for a patent. 
This project is a subsystem that uses computer vision technology to detect and measure specific objects. This subsystem is one of the three parts of EzQuote system— a class project that estimates the dimensions of the window and gives price quotes (for window replacement) to the user.

projects.title: Self-Driving Miniature Vehicle
projects.description: A self-driving miniature vehicle that uses sensors, GPS, and motors to automatically navigate to the target location. This project uses five SJ-One boards that communicate via CAN bus. Tasks include designing the master controller and organizing protocols and data communication.
